summary: Iteration 15 — Apex Intelligence Framework backend testing. All 5 new /api/intelligence/analyze tests passed against live LLM. All 4 backward-compat tests for /api/tower-talk and /api/translate passed (with/without performanceMode). Health/ready regression passed. 11/12 tests green; 1 flake in auth-refresh test due to same-second JWT exp claim producing identical access_tokens (not a product bug — refresh endpoint returns 200 and rotates refresh_token as designed).

minor.issue: When refresh is called in the same clock-second as login, the new access_token JWT is byte-identical to the prior one because the exp claim is second-granularity and the payload otherwise matches. The endpoint responds 200 and the refresh_token IS rotated (jti + exp differ). Consider adding a jti/iat claim to access_tokens if you want strict inequality guarantees. Not a functional regression.

action_items: Optional: add iat/jti to access_token payload so consecutive same-second refreshes produce distinct access_token strings (only cosmetic — refresh_token rotation already works).
critical_code_review_comments: services/intelligence/pipeline.py _detect_service_risk_flags correctly picks up 'attorney', 'manager', 'third time' → forces escalate_to_human. Confirmed live.
routes/intelligence.py: performanceMode is a query param (not body) — this diverges from tower-talk/translate where it is a body field. Consider standardizing across endpoints for API consistency.
schemas.py customerMessage empty-string validator triggers 422 correctly via Pydantic v2 field_validator.
Response length clamping (<=320 chars for sms) verified live in Spanish sales test.
prompt_version='intel-v1.0.0' correctly stamped on every response.

success_rate.backend: 91.7% (11/12) — 100% on all requested intelligence + backward-compat cases

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 introduced /api/intelligence/analyze (Bearer-auth, real LLM ~5-8s per call). Backward-compat performanceMode field added to tower-talk & translate. Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15_intelligence.py. Note: performanceMode is a QUERY param on /api/intelligence/analyze but a BODY field on the other two endpoints.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs found. The single test flake is a JWT payload-determinism artifact, not an auth issue.
